headline: Liberty Energy Shares Surge Following Q3 Sales Beat
summary: Liberty Energy stock soared after the energy services provider delivered third-quarter sales that surpassed expectations.
why: Liberty Energy provides hydraulic fracturing and completion services across North American oil and gas basins. Its revenue serves as a barometer for domestic drilling activity.

impacts.name: Liberty Energy Inc.
impacts.why: Stronger-than-projected quarterly sales drove investor enthusiasm and share price gains.

why_moved: Shares surged as third-quarter sales topped analyst estimates, signaling resilient demand for energy services.
